text:
nayla: Quick FYI - examples/sample-chat/README.md has drifted. The streaming JS snippet still shows `client.streamGenerate()` (old API) and manually sets `Authorization` header, while the top-level envs list `API_HOST` and `API_TOKEN`. New SDK uses client.chat.stream(...) and our canonical env names are REDWOOD_API_URL/REDWOOD_API_KEY. Users copy the snippet, paste into a file, and the stream errors out instantly.

matt: Oof. Can you paste the exact broken snippet?

nayla: Sure, current block:

```js
// outdated
const stream = client.streamGenerate({ model: 'redwood-chat-1', input: 'hi' })
for await (const part of stream) {
  process.stdout.write(part.text)
}
```

And the header example above shows:

```bash
export API_HOST=api.redwood.ai
export API_TOKEN=sk-OLD
curl "$API_HOST/v1/chat/stream" -H "Authorization: Token $API_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}'
```

sophie: Yikes. That's two separate drifts: (1) streaming method renamed, (2) env and auth header mismatch. Users hit a 400 from staging when they follow this.

matt: Proposed replacement JS streaming snippet (modern API uses chat.stream and SDK handles Authorization if instantiated with apiKey):

```js
// current
const iter = await client.chat.stream({ model: 'redwood-chat-1', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'hi' }] })
for await (const chunk of iter) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.delta || '')
}
```

And canonical curl/env guidance:

```bash
export REDWOOD_API_URL=https://api.redwood.ai
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-REPLACE_ME

curl "$REDWOOD_API_URL/v1/chat/stream" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}'
```

sophie: Also add a note under the streaming section: "If using the SDK, prefer client.chat.stream(...) and pass apiKey into the client constructor; do not set an Authorization header manually or you may double-auth and see 401/400 depending on proxy behavior."

nayla: I'll open the docs PR and include a tiny automated test that runs the sample against staging to catch this in future. Assigning @matt to review and @sophie to sanity-check the curl examples.

docs-bot: created docs issue #3722: chat streaming sample drift + auth env canonicalization.

ci-bot: heads up - docs PR 611 failed lint: missing blank line before fenced code block and trailing whitespace on line 78.

matt: I'll take the review and fix the lint comments after the PR lands. Thanks for catching this, Nayla — tiny copy/paste differences are a major onboarding friction. :raised_hands:
